sections.title: Understanding the Opa Unit
sections.content: An opa unit is a way to measure distance. According to the source material, one opa unit is equal to four metres.

sections.title: Calculating Nine Units
sections.content:
To find the total distance of nine units, you multiply the number of units by the length of one unit.

Calculation:
9 units x 4 metres per unit = 36 metres.

The source material confirms that nine units measure thirty-six metres.

lesson.title: Understanding One Third

sections.title: What is a Third?
sections.content: One third is one of three equal parts of a whole group. To be equal means that each part has the same number.

sections.title: Sharing Apples
sections.content: If you have twelve apples and share them equally among three people, each person gets four apples. In this example, four apples is one third of the twelve apples.

lesson.summary: One third means dividing a whole group into three equal parts. When we share twelve apples with three people, each person receives four apples, which represents one third.

vocabulary.definition: Having the same number or amount.

discussion_questions: If you share twelve apples with three people equally, how many apples does each person get?
What does it mean for parts to be equal?
objectives: Explain one third in simple words
lesson.content:
One third is one of three equal parts of a whole group. To be equal means that each part has the same number.

If you have twelve apples and share them equally among three people, each person gets four apples. In this example, four apples is one third of the twelve apples.

exercises.question: How many total tokens are there in four rema bags?
exercises.explanation: According to the source data, there are four rema bags and each bag contains nine tokens. To find the total, you multiply 4 (bags) by 9 (tokens per bag), which equals 36.
hints: Think about how many tokens are in just one bag.
If one bag has 9 tokens, how many would be in two bags?
Multiply the number of bags by the number of tokens in each bag.

exercises.question: How many kopi cubes are there in total if there are 7 packs and each pack has 3 cubes?
exercises.explanation: According to the source data, there are seven kopi packs and each pack holds three cubes. To find the total, you multiply 7 by 3, which equals 21 (Source: SLM_SOURCE_0).
hints: Think about how many cubes are in just one pack.
If there is 1 pack of 3, and another pack of 3, how many do you have now?
You need to count the number 3 seven times.

questions.question_text: In the story about five people and twenty disks, why is the sharing called 'equal'?
questions.explanation: The text states that equal sharing means everyone receives the same number. In this case, each person gets four disks [segment:1].
